_about: Example DObj slot config for a Melee Luigi target. Fill the indices from `skin.py target PlLgNr.dat --fighter luigi --plco PlCo.dat -o t.json` (dobjs[].joint shows the owning joint) and the source object names from the source JSON. Slots not listed keep the retail mesh. mode: replace (objects + optional textures per retail TObj slot, null = keep retail image; alpha_test), keep, blank.
